title: Decision provider
description: A System-1 decision model answers typed questions (yes/no, pick one, score) in one fast pass. The IM reply copilot uses it to read intent and risk and to rank drafted replies; plugins reach it through ctx.decisions.

provider.label: Provider
provider.noneHint: Without a provider, the reply copilot still drafts replies but cannot judge the conversation or rank the drafts.
provider.hint: Every request is redacted before it reaches the provider.
provider.missing: The selected provider is not installed or its plugin is disabled.

traits.copilotNotValidated: Not validated for the reply copilot

http.keySaved: A key is saved — paste a new one to replace it
http.keyringUnavailable: The key could not be stored: the secure store is unavailable on this device.

problems.no_url: The custom endpoint needs a URL.
problems.bad_url: The URL must use https (plain http only for localhost).
problems.no_model: The endpoint needs a model id.

errors.no_provider: No provider is selected or it is not installed.
errors.provider_unavailable: The provider is not ready yet (the model may still be loading).
errors.not_configured: The endpoint is missing a URL, model or API key.
errors.invalid_request: The provider rejected the request as malformed.
errors.pii: The request still contained personal data after redaction, so nothing was sent.
errors.network: The endpoint could not be reached.
errors.http_status: The endpoint answered with an error status.
errors.cors_unreachable: The browser version cannot reach this endpoint. Use the desktop or mobile app.
errors.timeout: The provider did not answer in time.
errors.recursive_provider: A plugin cannot route decisions through its own provider.

privacy: Chat text sent for a decision has emails, phone numbers, IDs and keys replaced with placeholders first. Remote endpoints receive only that redacted text.
